subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_h_ _ cd_p_c_h_k_dh_k_
solution:
Given sequence: _h__cd_p_c_h_k_dh_k_

 
• phcdkpchdk → **p**h**hc**c - d**d**p**k**c - **p**h**c**k**h **-** **dh**d**k**k**
 
• phdkpchkpc → ​**p**h**hd**c - d**k**p**p**c - **c**h**h**k**k - **dh**p**k**c**
 
• dphkchdpck → ​**d**h**ph**c - d**k**p**c**c - **h**h**d**k**p **-** **dh**c**k**k**
 
• ​dpkhkdpcpc → **d**h**pk**c - d**h**p**k**c - **d**h**p**k**c **-** **dh**p**k**c**

 
• In option 4, dhpkc is repeated

Hence, ‘**dpkhkdpcpc**’ is the correct answer.
